result.reason: The operative language substantially reaches the preferred position: the cap is mutual and aggregate, uses the greater of 12 months’ paid-or-payable fees and USD 1,000,000, includes all specified uncapped carve-outs, preserves the mutual consequential-damages exclusion, and excludes Company’s fee obligations from the cap. The revisions are appropriately limited to correcting the cap structure and carve-outs while retaining the existing damages exclusion. Minor drafting deviations prevent a top score: the lookback runs from the event giving rise to the claim rather than the claim itself, and the payment exclusion refers only to fees rather than all Customer payment obligations. The margin comment also omits data protection and security from its summary, although the operative clause includes them.
